ÖBB · Dovetail Games · TCA Quadrant Airbus

1020 Krokodil

Cab setup

  • Pantograph, Hauptschalter, compressor and battery in the cab
  • PARK BRK up: master key and brake key in (the valve is locked without them), reverser lock held
  • SiFa and PZB on (aux squares; both load switched off), PZB mode in the cab
  • Richtungsschalter Off to Forward: it only moves at Fahrstufe 0
  • Lights to Front 3 full, or Front + rear for shunting
  • Zusatzbremse at Hold, Führerbremsventil at Full

Cleared to depart

  • Check the signal and PZB, release the handbrake in the cab
  • Führerbremsventil to Running once ready; Zusatzbremse to Release
  • Mode switch right winds the tap changer up (Fahrstufe 0..18), left down; the left lever does the same in pulses
  • Acknowledge SiFa with the gear lever, PZB with the ENG switches
  • Brake: wind down to Fahrstufe 0, Führerbremsventil into the service zone; Emergency at the far end
  • Stop: Zusatzbremse to Apply; the reverser only moves at Fahrstufe 0
